name: PT Atlas Nexus Group Tbk
summary: PT Atlas Nexus Group Tbk manufactures and sells agricultural drones. It offers drones, such as agricultural protection, inspection and survey, and logistics and emergency response drones; vehicle trading and sales; cross border e-commerce; and furniture manufacturing and sales. PT Atlas Nexus Group Tbk was formerly known as PT Oscar Mitra Sukses Sejahtera Tbk and changed its name to PT Atlas Nexus Group Tbk in July 2026. PT Atlas Nexus Group Tbk was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia.
